title: Technician I Water and Irrigation Shift Record
description: A controlled worksheet for solution identity, pH and EC context, irrigation delivery, root-zone observations, exceptions, and escalation.
instructions: Verify the work order, room, batch, solution, and meter identity before measuring or delivering.
Record actual measurements and delivery rather than copying planned values.
Keep local emitter or root-zone exceptions separate from room-wide conclusions.
Escalate recipe, repair, treatment, or process changes outside Technician I authority.
limitations: pH and EC do not identify a specific nutrient deficiency, toxicity, or antagonism by themselves.
This template does not authorize nutrient-recipe changes or equipment repair.
